purpose: Runtime and force-field preflight contract. No atomistic result may be generated until this gate is closed.

python_policy.interpreter: Repository .venv or explicitly recorded bundled runtime

engine_contract.version_policy: Freeze exact installed version and platform after preflight.
engine_contract.platform_policy: CPU smoke test required before optional GPU execution.
engine_contract.trajectory_format: DCD or NetCDF plus topology and machine-readable run contract
engine_contract.seed_policy: Fixed seed list recorded per replica; ensemble statistics are the reproducibility unit.

force_field_contract.name: AMBER ff14SB
force_field_contract.ions: explicit; concentration and ion parameters must be recorded
force_field_contract.parameter_provenance: Must be frozen to the exact engine distribution and file hashes before Wave 1.

blocked_until: required packages are importable with exact versions recorded
force-field and water/ion assets are present and hashed
claim_boundary: A missing runtime or source cohort blocks atomistic result generation. It does not justify a synthetic replacement or a biological folding claim.
